thread:
Noah: Quick thread  We need to pick default autoscale hysteresis for Dedicated pools. Customers reported oscillations when traffic has diurnal bursts. Options: 1) conservative hysteresis (long cooldown), 2) short hysteresis + smoothing (moving avg), 3) adaptive hysteresis based on recent volatility. Want to land a safe GA default and a path for later refinement.

Ivy: Conservative hysteresis (e.g., scale down only after 10m stable under threshold, scale up immediately) reduces flapping but increases cost. Smoothing with a 2m moving avg is a good middle ground.

Sanjay: Adaptive hysteresis sounds ideal: compute volatility sigma and set cooldown = base + k*sigma. But complexity and observation delays may bite. Recommend start with smoothing + config knobs.

Elle: Product value: we should present two presets in Console: "Stable" (long cooldown, cost-friendly) and "Responsive" (short cooldown, more aggressive scaling). Default to Stable for GA. Also expose a "volatility" metric.

Noah: Agreed default = Stable (scale down cooldown 10m, scale up threshold 70%, down threshold 40%). We'll add a smoothing window = 2m moving avg to prevent microbursts from causing churn.

Ivy: Runbook: alert when pool scales >3x in 30m or scales up/down more than 4 times in 1h. Also documented rollback steps if autoscaler causes capacity debt.

Sanjay: Implementation note: moving avg computed in request router; cooldown enforced by controller. We'll flag metrics: "scale_ops_count" and "instance_lifetime" to validate.

Elle: UX: presets + advanced knobs (cooldown secs, smoothing window, min_instances). Also a tooltip explaining cost vs latency tradeoff.

ops-bot: scheduled: create-epic "autoscale-hysteresis-presets" assigned to @Noah,@Ivy,@Sanjay,@Elle due 2025-03-28

Noah: I'll draft GA defaults and add to the Dedicated rollout checklist.

Ivy: I'll update runbook and alerts.

Sanjay: I'll prototype the moving avg and the scale controller changes.

Elle: I'll add Console presets and copy for the tooltips.

Noah: Locking default unless anyone screams. :thumbsup:
